sources.title: Chongqing Wulong Karst Travel Guide for First Timers 2026
sources.content:
Wulong is a UNESCO World Heritage Site in Chongqing featuring dramatic karst landscapes.

Top Attractions:

Three Natural Bridges: Three massive natural bridges created by giant sinkholes, featuring Tianlong Bridge (thumbs-up shape), Qinglong Bridge (blade-like appearance), and Heilong Bridge (dark and moody passage). The viewing platform above Tianfu Post is a must for iconic photography.

Longshuixia Gorge: A shadowy canyon with calm, cyan-coloured streams and waterfalls. Features steep cliff steps with low-hanging rocks requiring ducking. A raincoat works better than an umbrella due to constant dampness.

Fairy Mountain: Alpine grassland area featuring wide-open grasslands with Thomas train service. Fog is common, especially on rainy days, in autumn, and in winter. Offers seasonal activities: camping, horse riding, skiing.

Furong Cave: One of China's largest karst caves maintaining constant 16-18°C. Contains stalactites and stalagmites under colored lighting. Involves lots of stairs with damp, slippery surfaces.

Impression Wulong Show: Large-scale outdoor show directed by Zhang Yimou running 70 minutes starting 8 pm, showcasing local customs including Chuanjiang working songs and hot pot culture.

Transportation: By Driving 2.5 hours. By Train: bullet train 60-120 CNY or regular train 20+ CNY, total journey 2-3 hours.

Itinerary: Day Trip possible via train. Two Days recommended: Day 1 covers Three Natural Bridges and Longshuixia Gorge; Day 2 includes Fairy Mountain and Furong Cave.

Best Times: Spring (Mar-May) 10-27°C with fewer tourists. Summer (Jun-Aug) cool 25°C in scenic areas. Autumn (Sep-Nov) mild and cost-effective. Winter (Dec-Feb) higher chance of snow on Fairy Mountain.

Accommodation: Fairy Town recommended as most convenient base.

Practical Tips: Avoid public holidays. Check WeChat account "游在武隆" for real-time conditions. Bring raincoat. Layer clothing for altitude changes.

sources.title: Wulong Karst, Chongqing Wulong National Park
sources.content:
Wulong Karst Geological Park is mainly composed of 4 attractions - Three Natural Bridges, Fairy Mountain, Longshuixia Gap and Furong Cave. The Three Natural Bridges in Wulong are the largest bridge cluster in Asia. Furong Cave is one of China's largest karst caves.

Typically it requires 1-2 days to visit the Wulong Karst Region, including travel to and from Chongqing. Driving (2-3h) and Train (1-2h) are the most common ways to get to Wulong from Chongqing.

sources.title: Wulong Karst National Geology Park: Facts, Attractions
sources.content:
Wulong Karst National Geology Park facts and attractions. The park features the Three Natural Bridges, which are the largest natural bridge group in Asia, Furong Cave, Longshuixia Gorge, and Fairy Mountain. UNESCO World Heritage Site since 2007.

Bring an umbrella or buy a raincoat (5-10 RMB in the park) on rainy days. Wear non-slip sports shoes as stone steps can be slippery. Enter the park at 8 AM or after 2 PM to avoid large tour groups.

sources.title: CHINA - Wulong Karst National Park day trip from Chongqing
sources.content: Wulong Karst National Park day trip from Chongqing blog post. A firsthand account of visiting the Three Natural Bridges and Longshuixia Gorge on a day trip. The scenery is absolutely stunning with massive natural stone bridges and deep canyons. Spring, autumn and winter are the best times to visit Wulong. Wulong is easily accessible by high-speed train from downtown Chongqing, taking about 1 hour and usually costs 100-130 RMB.

sources.title: Wulong Karst Geological Park (2026) - Tripadvisor
sources.content: Wulong Karst Geological Park visitor reviews. Spectacular natural scenery with massive karst formations. The Three Natural Bridges are the highlight. Allow at least a full day. The Impression Wulong show in the evening is highly recommended. Book accommodation in Fairy Town for convenience.

sources.title: 武隆喀斯特旅游区_百度百科
sources.content:
喀斯特旅游区位于重庆市武隆区，是国家5A级旅游景区，2011年被评为5A级景区，由天生三桥、仙女山、芙蓉洞三大核心景区组成。该景区拥有溶洞、天坑、地缝、峡谷等喀斯特地貌景观及少数民族民俗风情，属亚热带季风性湿润气候，年均气温17.4℃。

天生三桥：形成于50万年至3亿年间，由天龙桥、青龙桥、黑龙桥构成亚洲最大天生桥群，桥面平均高度超246米。景区内有垂直高度135.85米的悬崖360度旋转电梯。

仙女山：平均海拔1900米，以高山草原和林海雪原景观著称，建有滑雪场、露营基地等设施。

芙蓉洞：全长2700米，被中国洞穴协会会长评价为地下艺术宫殿，分布巨幕飞瀑、珊瑚瑶池等钟乳石奇观。

龙水峡地缝：峡谷长5公里，谷深200-500米。

历史沿革：1993年5月芙蓉洞被发现。1994年5月1日芙蓉洞对外开放。2000年天生三桥开放。2007年列入世界自然遗产名录。

门票价格：天生三桥淡季40元旺季70元；仙女山50元；芙蓉洞淡季65元旺季80元。

特色美食：大脚菌和蕨粑腊肉。

sources.title: 旅游攻略|武隆喀斯特地貌的探秘之旅 - 武隆旅游网
sources.content: 武隆喀斯特地貌探秘之旅攻略。穿越天坑地缝，邂逅地质奇观。武隆喀斯特旅游区包含天生三桥、仙女山、芙蓉洞等核心景点，2007年作为中国南方喀斯特的组成部分被列入联合国世界自然遗产。自驾经渝湘高速可抵达，非自驾游客可在重庆南坪汽车站、龙头寺火车站或高铁武隆南站换乘公交前往。
